brief: W1-07 round 2 at ULTRACODE. Round 1 scored 1.5/10. Close GAP-W1-creation-is-an-api-not-a-scene and the five other named gaps.
gap: GAP-W1-creation-is-an-api-not-a-scene — 19 census nodes produce 20 byte-identical PNGs; 0 entities; no UI layer of any kind exists in the build.
plan: P0 instrumentation: a UI layer drawn INTO the WebGL canvas (canvas.toDataURL is the screenshot path, so a DOM overlay would not be captured by __HARNESS.screenshot). Orthographic overlay scene + 2D-canvas texture.

P1 the scene: writ-house interior geometry + barge hold, jeeh-ei and warden-scribe-tuleeh-ma as real entities, camera in the interior, helstrom-market / stormhold-street / rootlands-well-graph states.
P2 gamepad: a real gamepad path in input/real.js + tools/journey/gamepad-shim.mjs, census completable on stick+buttons alone.
P3 derivation: hp_max/stamina_max/focus_max from VIG/END/WIL per RI-PRG02 §3; birthsign powers and drawbacks applied to the live sim.
P4 skills by use: RI-PRG03 §3 point table wired to combat events with the §4 Cost Gate.
P5 AR-3: find why encounter members never attack.
P6 race in the world: requires.race/forbids.race on topics, greeting-line volume, getPriceQuote derives Mercantile+PERSONALITY from the character.
findings: The build has NO UI layer at all. game/index.html is a bare canvas; game/src/render/ has renderer/scene/sky and nothing else. There is no DOM surface and no in-canvas surface.

__HARNESS.screenshot() = engine.renderer.screenshotDataURL() = canvas.toDataURL, which captures ONLY the WebGL canvas. The critic's probe uses page.screenshot() which would capture DOM. To satisfy both, the UI must be rendered into the WebGL canvas.
hp_max is hardcoded: game/src/combat/system.js:45 `hpMax: loadout.hpMax !== undefined ? loadout.hpMax : 620`. setCharacter never touches it. That is the whole of the RI-PRG02 finding.
focus: sim/state.js:70 focus/focusMax 0, focusLocked true by default; magic/cost.js focusMaxFor(wil) exists but the census never calls it.
No gamepad code exists anywhere in game/src.
tools/journey/ does not exist; A-JRN1's journey-run.mjs, beat-extract.mjs, gamepad-shim.mjs have never been written, which is why RI-JRN01 scored 0 fail-closed.

measured.gamepad_only: creation completed on a standard-mapping pad in 37 button presses plus one left-stick walk out of the barge hold. RealInput.pollGamepad is the same code path a real GameSir X2s takes.

measured.focus_and_birthsign: nu-ixtu WIL11 focus_max 53 vs base 33 (x1.60); kaal-kaal+nu-ixtu 43 (x1.30, half the deviation); focus_restores_at_hearth false for both and true for raj-xul. hearthRest() returns the difference.
measured.skills_by_use: 35 connecting hits over 3,400 frames bank 35 progress points into Blades (RI-PRG03 §3: 1 point per connecting hit; progressToNext(25)=46). 70 swings at empty air bank 0. grantSkillUse('lock_picked',{cost:0}) is refused by the Cost Gate; {cost:1} moves Security 5->6. The §4 rest clamp holds a skill to +3 levels between rests and hearthRest() resets it (5->8, rest, 8->11).

Round 1: 0 events, closest 18.198 m, 0 attack_start in all three.
measured.prices: §4b table reproduced exactly on buy_surcharge_only/sell_surcharge_only (54/70/76, 66/52/47). Mercantile-100/PER-60 Dunmer effective buy 1.0112x (bar [0.98,1.05]) DERIVED from the character; untrained 1.5073x. The two differ by 0.4961; round 1 they were identical.
measured.dialogue_volume: greetings 300/300 cells, 1,500 lines (1,400 distinct; RG-COURT is deliberately identical across all five player-race classes because that row is all zeros). 96 race-gated topic records, 32 with forbids.race. 16 race-gated rumours over 8 settlements. 61 slavery lines, 16 to a Dunmer.

not_closed: RI-JRN01's instrumented pass still scores 0 fail-closed: tools/journey/journey-run.mjs (A-JRN1), beat-extract.mjs and gamepad-shim.mjs do not exist. tools/harness/w1-07-scene.mjs measures M4/M5/M6/M13 directly, but the item's binding rule is the tool, not the number. RI-MTH06 already has this filed.
tools/analysis/build-viability.mjs still does not exist, so RI-CHR01 M6 and RI-CHR03 M5 remain unrunnable.

The Saxhleel raid run whiffs 10 of 12 swings at sub-1 m contact range. The capture fires from the nets instead, which is the correct fiction, but the melee hit rate at contact distance is a W1-09 resolver interaction I did not chase.
greetings.json is 1,500 lines expanded from 360 authored fragments, declared in the file's own provenance block. It is not 1,500 hand-written lines and does not claim to be.
Nord/Orsimer skill-set collision and unreachable Polearms remain corpus defects, unchanged.
